text.intro: Explore, find food and keep warm. Rest somewhere safe at night.
text.night_hint: It's night. Find somewhere safe to sleep.
text.too_exposed: Too exposed to sleep! Find somewhere safe first.
text.rain_start: It's starting to rain. Find shelter to stay warm.
text.chased: Something is chasing you! Run and hide!

text.night_hint: It's night. Fly into a tree's leaves to roost and sleep.
text.too_exposed: Too exposed to sleep! Fly into a tree's leaves to roost.
text.sheltered: You're safe, roosting in the tree.
text.rain_start: It's starting to rain. Roost in a tree's leaves to stay dry.
text.chased: Something is after you! Take to the air!

text.night_hint: It's night. Swim down to deep water to rest.
text.too_exposed: Too exposed to rest! Swim down to deep water first.
text.sheltered: You're resting safely in deep water.
text.rain_start: Raindrops patter on the lake surface above.
text.rain_stop: The rain has stopped. The lake goes still.
text.out_of_water: Fish need water! Back into the lake you go.

text.night_hint: It's night. Crawl into a tree's leaves, or under an earth overhang, to sleep.
text.too_exposed: Too exposed to sleep! Crawl into a tree's leaves, or under an earth overhang.
text.rain_start: It's starting to rain. Wet wings are slow and cold: hide in a tree's leaves or under an overhang.
